chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Singing Lucky to Me with Nica Shaw in Blackbirds
summary: He sang the love song Lucky to Me to Nica Shaw, with Ethel Waters reprising it, and sings the lyrics.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: What was "Blackbirds" about? What was that story?

Just a whole lot of entertainment and the love scene, I used to do a love scene with a girl called Nica Shaw. I used to sing a song to this girl concerning 'Lucky To Me' and we did a 'Lucky To Me' song to her which was a very good song. And then we did --- Ethel Waters did a reprise on that song after we sang it and this girl and I did a dance to this song.

And a melody of this song was very pretty: "Never since a child Was I reconciled By the folkd who laughed At boo-boo-boo Who just haunted me Tell me constantly 'Til the day you came my way Like good news Whenever you're near All my fears disappear, dear It's plain as can be You're lucky to me My only luck charms Are your two loving arms Anybody can see You're lucky to me No harm can happen to me any more I'm writing 13's all over my door My mother and dad thought that Our luck was bad Now like we they agree Your lucky to me"

There was a repeat on that, singing the same song. It was a lovely number. And I did a dance, did a harmony to the song and we did a dance together to close the song off, which was very good, very good. Poor thing. She's dead now, God rest her soul. We had a good number.
She was. She was, very clever girl.
Not much. We did a soft-shoe dance, picture dance, you know. Which was very nice, very nice. I loved working with her. And the show finally folded up after about 12 weeks, 12 or 14 weeks.
